    - article:
      - heading "Collatz Conjecture (Statement)" [level=2]
      - paragraph: For all positive integers n, repeatedly applying
      - paragraph: T(n) = n/2 if n is even T(n) = 3n + 1 if n is odd
      - paragraph: eventually reaches 1.
      - text: This is a conjecture, not a proof.
    - article:
      - heading "Key Definitions" [level=2]
      - text: Total stopping time
      - paragraph: Number of transitions needed to reach 1 for the first time. For n=1 it is zero.
      - text: Peak value
      - paragraph: Maximum value in the orbit up to first reaching 1, including its start.
    - article:
      - heading "Evidence vs Proof" [level=2]
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: Compute cases. Find patterns and bounds. Build evidence.
      - text: Proof must cover every positive integer.
    - article:
      - heading "Why Not Millions?" [level=2]
      - paragraph: No finite collection of checked starts covers infinitely many positive integers.
      - img
      - paragraph: These computations cannot replace a proof.
    - article:
      - heading "Important Warning" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: Important Warning
      - paragraph: A shortcut to a lower start is justified only if that lower start is already proved to reach 1.
      - paragraph: This search computes each orbit with an explicit limit.
